title: Towards Cognitive Synergy in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems: Integrating Theory of Mind and Critical Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate multi-agent dialogues based on a qualitative rubric that measures argument quality, critical engagement, reference cohesion, and risk resolution. The evaluation specifically tests whether integrating a Critic Agent and Theory of Mind (ToM) mitigates logical fallacies and 'System 1' intuitive reasoning biases in a strategic investment decision-making scenario.
